comment: ANCHOR: REPRICER_SESSION_SOURCE_20261102 — holdings reprice around the clock on trading days (operator 2026-11-02:
"repricing needs to run 24 hours as we have 24-hour markets"); reprice_source names the real session
(finviz_premarket / finviz_live / finviz_afterhours / finviz_overnight) via scripts/market_session.py; overnight
fills come from the session the prices describe; quote selection knows every session source.
Hermetic: fixed datetimes, no network, no DB.
